best_idea: A kill pays a standing award that scales with the victim's rank and level, is split across in-range party members by integer division, and ranks up on per-rank thresholds with the overshoot carried, so favour is earned by kills and shared by a party.
decision_why: Keep the tier-scaled kill award, the in-range party split and the rank thresholds as the favour ledger on a server-verified kill; reject the donor's rank-up carry (it double-counts) and reset progress to the overshoot; make the constants data.
acceptance: A solo kill of a rank-10, level-40 player gives 280 standing; a party of three, all in range, gives each 93; with threshold 1000, standing 990 and gain 50, the player ranks up and shows 40 progress, not 1030; at the top rank gains stop.
